title: DMS
description: Atmospheric, dark and horror styled shader
body:
![DMS_Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d112d2c6c352ea8e142b9e934991365af612e069_0.webp)


A gritty, desaturated, and deeply atmospheric overhaul for Minecraft, designed to transform your world into a dark fantasy or survival horror experience.

 

**DMS** completely strips away the vibrant, saturated look of vanilla Minecraft, replacing it with a bleak, weathered color palette and harsh dynamic lighting.

 





 

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/243d22337b77a77d0b5ac583708bfc161c5e6391.png)






- **Gritty, Realistic Colors:** No more bright, radioactive vanilla greens. The world is shifted to a weathered, cinematic palette.
  
- **Heavy, Atmospheric Fog:** Distance fog rolls in cleanly to give you that perfect, moody, overcast weather vibe.
  
- **Immersive Border Shadows:** A clean vignette darkens the corners of your screen, making you feel completely locked into your surroundings.
  
- **Harsh, Deep Shadows:** Underneath trees, cliffs, and hillsides, the shadows get realistically dark and intense.
  
- **Pitch-Black Nights:** True survival nights where navigating without torches is nearly impossible.
  
- **Realistic Torches:** Torchlight doesn't artificially light up a massive area; it gives off a cozy, highly localized glow.
